_comment: Jokes for the tutor to tell. NOT a content pack: this file is never loaded
into the retrieval corpus, because a joke chunk that can be retrieved will
eventually be retrieved for a real question, and a punchline is a terrible
thing to ground a science answer on.
Setup and punchline are separate fields so they are spoken as two
sentences. The device speaks sentence by sentence, so the split IS the
comic pause - one line then a beat then the answer. Written together they
would be delivered in one breath and stop being jokes.
Chosen to work by EAR. No spelling gags, nothing that needs to be seen.
Dealt from a no-repeat deck (tutor/deck.py); with 44 here a party runs a
long time before anything comes round again.
